title: The Eye of the Storm
subtitle: You can now see everything unveiled here. Your option is to die or to apply yourself to the creation of a new order.

trails.title: Trail ① Poem
trails.description: An unnamed poem written on a wrinkled piece of paper that reeks of dried sweat.

content.text:
Surrounded by imposing barriers,
Epics never sing of those about to die.
Look up, keep looking up,
A broken tile is the only shelter in the tempest.

People always knew how they took the wrong path,
So they regret the unregrettable nights, laugh at the laughable fools.
At the bottom of the cliff, a river always flows.

trails.title: Trail ① Tuning O' One
trails.description:
A record on how to call the tune.
Sometimes your decision can change the game.

items.text: The Eye of the Storm

items.speaker: X
items.text: That's all for what we know about the "Storm".
Institutum Lorentz Branch

items.speaker: X
items.text: That's all for what we know about the "Storm".

items.speaker: X
items.text: And what our Institutum does is to catch in advance any time, event, or place that may cause the "Storm."

items.speaker: X
items.text: For ourselves we call it—Chaotic Energy.

items.speaker: X
items.text: According to the latest research materials, we infer that the "Storm" that could reverse the world was caused by the "Original Butterfly," flapping its wings in the ancient time.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The ancient time you said ... is that the oldest of the oldest? Well, the time with no record?

items.speaker: X
items.text: I'm afraid it is.

items.speaker: X
items.text: The "Butterfly" created the prototype for the prehistoric Chaotic Energy, which became active and unstable through years of accumulation and evolution.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Someone took advantage of its instability, and created the "Storm" that could reverse the world.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So the circles on your map, are they the markings of where the "Storm" may occur this time?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: And the mark closest to us ... is now flashing with a red warning light.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Yes. Because it's in the eye of the "Storm."

items.speaker: X
items.text: In The Walden in Chicago ... where your friends are now.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Let us wish her the best of luck.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I finally got the answer.
Walden

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I finally got the answer.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are using history to expedite the "Storm."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Community conflicts, turbulent history, new technology ... all of these may lead to the "Storm."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Since the last day of 1999, the world has started to get reversed by the "Storm," one after another.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Which past do you want to return? Fifty years ago? A century ago? Or ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: The "past" with the right order, of course.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Well, I didn’t expect the human lackey to understand what the right order is.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Friends of The Walden all along, there is not much time for us.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Ask yourselves, who will enlighten you of the impending doom but we Manus Vindictae?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: The last 24 hours in your life, how are you going to spend them?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: To cry for your no-longer-valuable property? Lie to yourself that all this is not true?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Or to take our mission to rebuild the world, extend your lives, until you see the birth of a new order?

items.speaker: Vip Guest
items.text: Put on the mask ... and I won't get sifted out by the "Storm"?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: We will assure the safety of every one of us.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Please do not lie! You actually detained a human in your secret room!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: So, your first mission to join us Manus is ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: These government lackeys, who hide the truth of the "Storm" from you—take them down.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Are you really joining this insurgent organization? He is using your fears!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Ms. Sonetto, we are scared, but we are free. You know what I am talking about.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The rioters are here! Be careful! There are so many of them!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Where are my bodyguards!

items.speaker: Bodyguards
items.text: Ms. Sotheby, we are here! We'll have you surrounded, please stay inside!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: ... Of course Mr. Karson lied to me.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Fine. It's time to show the power of our manor. Ms. Sonetto, we are here to help!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Everyone else come with me! Let's break out!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Members
items.text: We've been waiting for this moment ...

items.speaker: Special Action Team Members
items.text: Let's go!
Don't hurt the innocents. Focus on the Manus!
items.edge_label: 不要伤及无辜民众，向重塑开战！

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Let's go!
TO BE CONTINUED…
